name: Takano Takuto
source:
Shiina's older brother, a young man on the verge of entering university who gets transported to the world of the gods.  He is kind-hearted and something of a pervert.
[spoiler]He is actually the reincarnation of Izanagi, the creator god of Shinto myth.[/spoiler]
